title: Phoenix Physics Collision Layer Matrix
description: Shape of project/Config/Physics/layers.json. Shape only: matrix symmetry, completeness, contiguous indices and the reserved index 0 are relations between entries. tools/validation/validate_registries.py enforces those.

maxLayers.description: AzPhysics::CollisionLayers::MaxCollisionLayers at O3DE tag 2605.0. Pinned as a constant so an engine upgrade that changes it fails this schema instead of silently widening the allowed index range.

collidesWith.description: Layer name to the layers it collides with. Must be symmetric and name every layer.
